items.title: Meta-learning for wrestling
items.summary: We show that for the task of simulated robot wrestling, a meta-learning agent can learn to quickly defeat a stronger non-meta-learning agent, and also show that the meta-learning agent can adapt to physical malfunction.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI展示了元学习（Meta-learning）在模拟机器人摔跤任务中的应用。研究表明，通过元学习训练的智能体不仅能快速击败更强的非元学习对手，还能在面对物理故障时表现出极强的适应能力。该成果验证了元学习在动态环境下的泛化潜力，为开发更具韧性的自主智能体提供了实验依据。

items.title: Competitive self-play
items.summary: We’ve found that self-play allows simulated AIs to discover physical skills like tackling, ducking, faking, kicking, catching, and diving for the ball, without explicitly designing an environment with these skills in mind. Self-play ensures that the environment is always the right difficulty for an AI to improve. Taken alongside our Dota 2 self-play results, we have increasing confidence that self-play will be a core
items.summaryZh: OpenAI通过研究发现，自我博弈（Self-play）机制能使模拟AI在无需人工干预的情况下，自动习得包括擒抱、假动作、踢球等复杂物理技能。该方法确保了训练环境始终保持适宜的难度，从而推动AI性能持续提升，被视为构建未来高性能AI系统的核心范式。
